business_summary.text: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited manufactures heat exchangers, cooling coils and HVAC&R solutions, including fin & tube coils, bar & plate, complete HVAC systems, bus AC systems and refrigeration components, from facilities in Neemrana, Rajasthan.

call_points.text: Developing liquid cooling products for evolving data centre technology.
Consolidated revenue grew 119% YoY in Q1FY27, which the CMD called a strong start to FY27.
Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded 418 bps to 19.44% from 15.26%.
Management expects 50% capacity utilization from the new facility in FY27.
Export order book stands at over ₹120 Cr including data center orders.
Board approved enabling resolution to raise up to ₹500 Cr via QIP, primarily for working capital.
Bus AC division targets ~₹160 Cr revenue in FY27 following the Sphere acquisition.
Exports targeted to reach ~30% of revenue mix in FY27, up from 16% in FY26.
Combined ~6.5% revenue-linked incentive uplift expected from PLI and RIPS once approvals flow through.

operating_notes.text: Plant II provides 6x existing capacity with a capex of ₹350 Cr.
Imported machines are in transit, leading to a minor delay in utilizing the remaining IPO proceeds for the Neemrana facility.
Sonu Gupta resigned as CFO effective May 14, 2026, and transitioned to Senior Management.
Wholly owned subsidiary KRN HVAC Products received RIPS-2024 approval for Neemrana plant with approved EFCI of ₹182.95 Cr and 1.40% turnover linked incentive.
Export order booking stands at over ₹120 Cr including data center orders.
New facility expected to reach 50% capacity utilization in FY27.
Promoters Santosh Kumar Yadav, Anju Devi, and Manohar Lal announced intention to sell up to 1,000,000 equity shares post QIP within two months.
Fund-Raising Committee opened QIP with floor price of ₹1,114.05 per share.
QIP completed raising ₹34,999.99 lakhs at ₹1,060 per share (4.85% discount to floor of ₹1,114.05).
Export revenue rose 177% YoY in Q1FY27, with products reaching customers in 14 countries.
Consolidated revenue mix in Q1FY27 was 79.24% domestic and 20.76% export.
FY26 consolidated operating cash flow was negative ₹113.80 Cr, with inventories at ₹272.91 Cr.
Export revenue share increased to 22.01% in H1FY27 from 15.69% in FY26.
USA is the largest export market, accounting for 43.75% of H1FY27 export revenue.
Company is developing liquid cooling solutions for the data centre segment.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹179.48 Cr (+36.5% YoY), net profit ₹23.36 Cr (+57.1% YoY).
KRN Heat Exchanger released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation outlining FY27 guidance, including a ₹160 Cr target for the Bus AC segment and Plant II scaling.
Crisil Ratings issued the Monitoring Agency Report for KRN Heat Exchanger showing ₹33,847.32 lakh of IPO proceeds utilized as of March 31, 2026.
KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited posted Q4 FY26 earnings conference call audio recording on 15 May 2026 via its website.
Sonu Gupta resigned as CFO of KRN Heat Exchanger effective May 14, 2026, remaining as a Senior Management Personnel.
KRN Heat Exchanger announced that its subsidiary KRN HVAC Products received RIPS-2024 approval for its Neemrana Plant with an approved EFCI of ₹182.95 Cr.
KRN Heat Exchanger reported Q4 and FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹609.81 Cr, up 38% YoY, and outlined plans for 50% utilization of its new facility in FY27.
Promoters Santosh Kumar Yadav, Anju Devi, and Manohar Lal notified an intention to sell up to 10,00,000 equity shares post QIP completion.
KRN Heat Exchanger opened its qualified institutions placement with a floor price of ₹1,114.05 per share.
KRN Heat Exchanger closed its QIP raising ~₹350 Cr via allocation of 33,01,886 shares at ₹1,060 per share.
KRN Heat Exchanger closes ₹350 Cr QIP at ₹1,060 per share
KRN Heat Exchanger filed its annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for FY26 reporting zero pledged shares.
KRN Heat Exchanger reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹252.32 Cr, up 119% YoY, with PAT of ₹32.90 Cr, up 165%.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹319.14 Cr (+109.9% YoY), net profit ₹36.11 Cr (+100.4% YoY).
KRN Heat Exchanger reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 110% YoY to ₹319.14 Cr, driven by data centre cooling and export growth.
